newsitem.title: GREECE: Cruise ship aground off Greek island, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Cruise ship aground off Greek island, no injuries.

text.p: An Italian-owned cruise ship with 1,500 tourists and 500 crew on board ran aground off a Greek island in the Aegean Sea on Saturday but there were no injuries, the Greek merchant marine ministry said in a statement.
The Liberian-flagged Costa Classica grounded on a sandy beach on the island of Kythira, south of the Peloponnese peninsula, after its anchor chain broke in strong winds.
"There is no danger for the passengers -- all foreign tourists -- or the crew. Two tugboats are on their way to tow the ship back to deep waters," the statement said.
